summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a Form 51-102F3 Material Change Report disclosing that on September 9, 2026 it amended and refiled its audited FY2025 and interim Q3 FY2026 financial statements and related MD&A. The refiling followed a British Columbia Securities Commission review and reclassified JGB First Warrants from senior secured loans to derivative financial liabilities, moving $7,716,025 from non-current to current liabilities with no change to total liabilities, equity, net loss or cash flows. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor mandate or transaction mechanics are stated; the event is an accounting restatement, not a special situation.
